1. Clara AI SDR

Tagline: Turn website visitors into qualified pipeline
Description: Clara is an AI SDR that converts inbound website traffic into pipeline - engaging, qualifying, demoing, handling objections, and booking meetings in real time. No forms. No waiting. No extra headcount. 24/7 selling with seamless CRM integration.

2. Taku AI

Tagline: Borrow the best AI setups and make them yours.
Description: AI is getting insanely powerful — and somehow harder to use. Taku fixes the last mile. It turns the best skills, agents, and workflows into real desktop apps anyone can run, remix, and make their own. Borrow setups from the pros, skip GitHub and setup, or just tell Taku what you want and watch it assemble the stack. The more you work, the more Taku learns what you need — and brings the right tools to you.
Website: open
Product Hunt: View on Product Hunt

Keyword: AI desktop apps, workflow automation, no-code AI, personalization, productivity tools, adaptive AI, smart assistant, AI setups, borrow workflows, customizable AI

3. Superflow AI

Tagline: AI agents that QA your website before launch
Description: Superflow turns the QA checklist you already use into a team of AI agents. They sweep every page, desktop and mobile, and pin every finding on the live site. Agents handle the black and white issues. Taste stays with you. Agents learn: rejected findings stop coming back, and misses become checks on future sites. Teams say they catch ~90% of what they found by hand. Works with Webflow, Framer, WordPress, Shopify, Next.js, Netlify + more.

7. Shepherd Terminal

Tagline: A persistent terminal for Codex and Claude side by side
Description: Run coding agents across tabs, panes, and remote machines. Shepherd keeps terminal sessions alive when the app closes, tracks which agents are working or waiting, and lets you return to their files and changes without losing context. Agents understand the current Shepherd context, control tabs and panes, and collect feedback through browser reviews, while you monitor every agent’s status in real time.

8. Reckon

Tagline: The decision journal that helps you calibrate
Description: Most decisions feel resolved the moment you make them. Reckon keeps what hindsight erases: the prediction, the confidence, the reasoning. Check-ins capture what changes before the outcome: new info tagged positive or negative, confidence updated. At resolution you log what happened; weeks later it asks if you’d still make the call. A year in, you see where confidence overshoots, where it undershoots, where judgment is sharpest. iPhone and iPad. iCloud sync, no account. One-time purchase.

10. Finch

Tagline: A single place for your health data and tests
Description: Finch is a patient-side health companion built for all — an expecting parent, or just someone navigating the health system. Pregnancy alone involves at least 12 appointments, dozens of test results, and a new vocabulary, coming from different providers in different formats. That’s just one example. Whatever your journey, Finch brings it into one clear view, transcribes what was said at your appointments, and translates clinical language into plain English. Free tier available. Finch+ $99/y
